# Moyosore Saibu

Official website: https://moyosoresaibu.com/

Moyosore Saibu's website is positioned around solving commercial growth problems: market research, customer growth, sales execution, route-to-market, retention and practical decision systems. Current and past workplace roles are used as evidence of experience, not as the main brand identity.

Main pages:
- Home: https://moyosoresaibu.com/
- Start: https://moyosoresaibu.com/start/
- Solutions: https://moyosoresaibu.com/projects
- Approach: https://moyosoresaibu.com/about
- Proof: https://moyosoresaibu.com/experience
- Growth system: https://moyosoresaibu.com/growth-system
- Customer retention system: https://moyosoresaibu.com/retention-system
- Insights: https://moyosoresaibu.com/insights/
- Evidence: https://moyosoresaibu.com/evidence
- Contact: https://moyosoresaibu.com/contact
- Retention health check: https://moyosoresaibu.com/tools/retention-health-check
- Privacy: https://moyosoresaibu.com/privacy

The /start/ page is a fast, scan-first landing page for visitors arriving from social bio links. It is indexed and distinct from the homepage.

Core website language is visitor-first: identify the visitor's problem, show the practical solution, then show evidence.
